QURANWBW INDOPAK TEXT AND ALQURANNEO FONT: TERMS AND PERMISSION
===============================================================

What it is
  Text:  IndoPak (Hanafi) Quran text, assets/quran/indopak.json, converted from
         the QuranWBW text file. Only the file format was changed. The Arabic
         text was not edited.
  Font:  AlQuranNeo, app/src/main/res/font/quran_neo_arabic.ttf, from the same
         QuranWBW package. The file was only renamed. It was not modified.
  Version stated in the package README: Quran text IndoPak v5.3.1, font
  AlQuranNeo v5.3.2 (released 06 September 2025). Maintained by Ayman Siddiqui
  and R. Siddiqua. Website: https://www.QuranWBW.com
  [Confirm the version: the download folder was labelled v5.4.]

This text and font are NOT covered by the GPLv3 license of the Iman source code.

Package README: "Copyright, Attribution & Usage Restrictions" (summary)
  The package contains Indopak Quranic text data, font files, and supporting
  resources prepared exclusively for the service of the Noble Qur'an and
  distributed as a Sadaqah Jariyah initiative. It incorporates work from
  various sources, and remains subject to the rights of its owners.

  Copyright holders and sources:
    (c) Ayman Siddiqui
    (c) Al-Qalam and Ghandhara Software
    (c) King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex (KFGQPC)
  All rights remain with their respective owners.

  Permitted, with prior written permission: personal use, educational use,
  research use, non-commercial Quranic projects, and Islamic learning
  applications. All subject to NO-ADS, NO-PAYWALL, and ONLY Sadaqa-e-Jaria with
  clear attribution.

  Permitted only with review and prior written permission: free (Sadaqa-e-Jaria)
  apps with paid premium features that do not contain ads, and educational
  platform projects that pay the teachers only and contain no ads.

  Strictly prohibited:
    - Sale of the font or the bundled package
    - Redistribution without attribution
    - Removal of credits or acknowledgements
    - Modification of font files
    - Creation of derivative font works
    - Commercial resale or relicensing
    - Misrepresentation of source or authorship

  Permissions and corrections: quranwbw[at]gmail.com

  Compatibility: from the IndoPak v5.x series, the text files work only with the
  accompanying AlQuranNeo v5.x font. Older fonts and third-party fonts are not
  supported and can render incorrectly.

Written permission
  Received from the QuranWBW Team by email on [DATE]. Keep the email. It is the
  proof of permission.

  Conditions given in that email (summarized)
  1. The project stays free (Sadaqa-e-Jaria) for all users, with no ads and no
     Quran text behind a paywall.
  2. The font is used only with its matching Quran text, with no modification.
     The text must appear exactly as on QUL, Quran.com, and QuranWBW.com.
  3. The font is used only to display Quran text, or duas from the Quran with
     reference to the exact ayah.
  4. The font is not used for anything else: no non-Quranic duas, notices,
     buttons, headings, or other text.
  5. Mention all credits listed in the package README (below), and state that
     prior permission was obtained to use the original, unmodified Quran text
     and font, with the permission restricted to displaying the Quran text only.
  They also prefer that the font is kept out of any open-source repository,
  because anyone could then use or distribute it without their permission.

How Iman follows this
  - The app is free, with no ads and no paywall. If a paid feature is ever
    added, ask QuranWBW for a review first (see "Permitted only with review").
  - The font is used only for IndoPak ayah text in the Quran reader, and for
    the 1:1 sample in the script picker, shown with its reference.
  - The Uthmani script uses Amiri Quran. All other Arabic text uses Noto Sans
    Arabic. The interface uses Plus Jakarta Sans.
  - The text and font files are not modified. The font file is not in the
    repository, and the README explains where to get it.
  - The credits below are in the README and in the app's About screen.

If the repository is made public
  Do not include the font file in it. It is already listed in .gitignore. Old
  copies stay in Git history, so publish from a fresh repository.
